akh.text: Hazoret is the god of zeal on Amonkhet, whose Trial of Zeal ends with the surviving initiate receiving the most Glorified Death from her forked staff.
She has Samut imprisoned with other dissenters, and when Samut asks whether Hazoret herself is mistaken, she curses her and orders the anointed to seize the dissenter.
Hazoret starts the final Trial and casts her mark of battle rage over everyone, but when she strikes at Djeru, Samut tackles him out of the way and Gideon blocks the spear with his golden barrier.
Then Bolas arrives, Bontu's spell unlocks Hazoret's suppressed memories, and after Bontu's death Hazoret alone remains as the last pillar of Amonkhet.

Injured and pursued by the scorpion god, she traps it in flame, and she finishes it with her spear after Samut cuts through its carapace, then tells the survivors to endure and leads them into the desert.

hou.text: Hazoret is dragged before the God-Pharaoh when Bontu exploits her compassion, but Bolas kills Bontu and Hazoret breaks free with her faithful, leaving her the only living god.
She fights the Scorpion God and is severely wounded, but she weakens its armor so Samut and others can kill it, and she vows to stand by the mortals.
Hazoret leads the survivors of Naktamun into the desert, becoming the God-Survivor, and gives her spear to Karn, Samut, Ob Nixilis and Dack Fayden after they defeat Tezzeret.
When the Eternals leave for Ravnica, she and the survivors reclaim Naktamun, raise the Hekma and begin rebuilding.
